name: M3_PPS200MI_GetLine
description:
Retrieve a single purchase order line and expose detailed information about the item, quantities, prices, logistics, and references. The operation returns a wide set of fields including company, purchase order and line identity, item and supplier data, dates, statuses, financial values, and user‑defined fields.

  
The item name, purchase order item name, and purchase order item description are not returned in full length in this operation. They are truncated to the standard output field length. To read these three descriptions in full, use the supplementary operation that returns the full item descriptions for a purchase order line (GetLineX).

inputParameters.name: PUNO
inputParameters.description: Purchase order number identifying the purchase order whose line will be retrieved.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number of the company that owns the purchase order; defaults to the logged-in company if not specified.

inputParameters.name: PNLI
inputParameters.description: Purchase order line number to retrieve.

inputParameters.name: PNLS
inputParameters.description: Purchase order line subnumber (suffix) used to identify a specific split of the line.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number that owns the purchase order.
